name: Fattening Daily Gain / Feed Conversion Ratio Curve

map.🐄 育肥日增重/料肉比曲线: 🐄 Finishing ADG / Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR) Curve
map.输入始末体重、育肥天数与总采食量，计算平均日增重（ADG）、料肉比（FCR）及每: Enter the start and end weights, finishing days and total feed intake to compute average daily gain (ADG), feed conversion ratio (FCR) and feed cost per kg gain, and give a growth-performance rating by species.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：Math.round(days×i÷segs)；i÷: Core formulas (by input): Math.round(days×i÷segs); i÷segs×100; adg×1000
map.📖 查看「育肥日增重/料肉比曲线 使用指南」: View "Finishing ADG / FCR Curve User Guide"
map.💡 公式：ADG = (期末体重 − 初始体重) ÷ 天数；FCR = 总采食量: 💡 Formula: ADG = (final weight − initial weight) ÷ days; FCR = total feed ÷ total gain; feed cost per kg gain = FCR × feed unit price.
map.曲线为按平均日增重线性推算的累计体重，仅供趋势参考，实际增重多呈 S 型: The curve is cumulative weight estimated linearly from average daily gain, for trend reference only; actual gain is mostly S-shaped.
map.评级标准为通用参考值，不同品种、饲养方式存在差异: Rating standards are general reference values; they differ by breed and feeding method.
map.📚 深度解析：育肥日增重与料肉比曲线: 📚 In-Depth: Finishing ADG and FCR Curve
map.由起止体重、天数、耗料求 ADG 与 FCR。: Derive ADG and FCR from start/end weight, days and feed used.
map.与品种基准分级对标。: Benchmark against breed standards and grade.
map.增重 180kg，ADG=180/120=1.5 kg/d，FCR=1100/1: Gain 180 kg, ADG=180/120=1.5 kg/d, FCR=1100/180=6.11, gain cost=6.11×3.2=19.55 yuan/kg, total feed cost 3520 yuan.
map.FCR 6.11 优于/劣于品种基准，给出评级与改进方向。: FCR 6.11 better/worse than the breed baseline, with a rating and improvement direction.
map.常用 kg/d 或 g/d（×1000），育肥牛约 1.0~1.5 kg/d。: Commonly kg/d or g/d (×1000); finishing cattle about 1.0~1.5 kg/d.
map.增重成本=FCR×料价，是育肥效益核心指标。: Gain cost = FCR × feed price, a core indicator of finishing profitability.
map.用于肉牛、猪、羊育肥阶段的生长性能评估。输入始末体重、育肥天数与总采食量，自动计: Used for growth-performance evaluation of cattle, pigs and sheep in the finishing stage. Enter the start and end weights, finishing days and total feed intake to automatically compute average daily gain (ADG), feed conversion ratio (FCR) and feed cost per kg gain, with a species rating and estimated weight-gain curve.
map.支持牛/猪/羊三种畜种评级: Supports rating for three species: cattle/pig/sheep
